_comment: Dummy Jira ticket dataset for demos/tests. No real Jira instance is connected yet (see design.md). Deliberately includes one clean ticket, one with missing acceptance criteria, and one with no repository link, to exercise ticket-intake's required behaviors.

tickets.title: Add a /healthz endpoint to repo-context-ai's CLI
tickets.description: Operators need a simple way to confirm the CLI tooling is installed correctly before wiring it into a repository's CI pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Running `node src/index.js healthz` prints a JSON object with a `status: "ok"` field and exits 0
The command requires no network access and no model credentials

tickets.title: Improve error messages somehow
tickets.description: Some error messages could be clearer.

tickets.title: Add retry logic to the model provider call
tickets.description: The OpenAI-compatible provider should retry once on a transient 5xx before failing.
acceptanceCriteria: A 5xx response triggers exactly one retry before the call is considered failed
A non-5xx failure (e.g. 401) does not retry

tickets.title: Unrelated ticket not marked eligible
tickets.description: This ticket intentionally lacks the automation-eligible marker and must never be picked up.
